nodes.title: How to test (merged)
widgets_values:
Smoke test for SAX Text Catalog merge_outputs = merged:

1. The node has merge_outputs toggle ON (merged). It exposes a single 'merged' output pin only.
2. The merged pin joins all active relations' texts with newlines:
   'a beautiful sunny landscape\nlow quality, blurry'
3. Connect the merged pin to a single input of SAX Prompt Concat.
   The result must match wiring the two individual outputs separately.
4. Toggle merge_outputs OFF (individual) -> two per-relation pins reappear (connections are dropped by design).
